market_view: Calm regime: VIX 15.5 (-15% in 20 days), 10-year eased to 4.64%, dollar soft. Metals are surging (gold 3-month high, copper at a 1-year high), crude fell 3% on Iran optimism, and NVDA results land around now (two-sided).

oil_gas.catalyst: none; NBC News 'Oil prices dip as cautious optimism over Iran trumps new fears of Russian escalation' points to easing, not a new supply loss
oil_gas.reasoning: WTI -3.1% on 08-25 as Iran optimism grows; the earlier sanctions threat is unwinding, not escalating. No unpriced closure or supply loss; Trump pressure on majors remains a downside risk. Stay flat.

gold_miners.catalyst: none new; Guardian 'Gold price hits three-month high amid fears over Iran war and Trump economy' is a driver move already in prices
gold_miners.reasoning: Planned exit date (about 08-24) has passed. NEM +47.7% in 20 days and at its 52-week high; gold +6.2% in 5 days is already priced. Yahoo cost-dilution headline adds two-sided risk. Close NEM, take profit, go flat.

chips.catalyst: none one-sided; NVIDIA Newsroom 'NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Second Quarter Fiscal 2027' is title-only with no numbers or guidance
chips.reasoning: Earnings outcome and guidance unknown from the title; AWS 2 million GPU deal and Hugging Face deal are positive but likely tied to the results. OpenAI Jalapeno competition story. Scheduled event, two-sided. Flat.

pharma.catalyst: none; only an FDA Listeria cheese notice, irrelevant to LLY
pharma.reasoning: No LLY-specific news; LLY -1.1% on 08-25 while MRK rallies on its own story. Sector near its high. Keep flat.

copper_uranium.catalyst: Congo copper concentrate export ban (carried from the handoff note), no reversal or exemption seen; copper now at its 1-year high (6.71, +3.5% in 5 days), confirming continued tightness
copper_uranium.reasoning: Continue FCX long started 2026-07-31 to its planned exit about 08-28. Exit triggers (ban reversal, copper breakdown, dollar rebound) absent; dollar soft. FCX +20.5% in 5 days raises pullback risk, so confidence only modest and short remaining horizon.

would_change_my_mind: A Congo ban exemption or copper reversal would close FCX; NVDA results with a clear guidance raise and no sell-off, or a new Hormuz supply loss, would justify NVDA or XOM longs.

handoff.what_changed: Crude fell (WTI 82.4, -3.1% on 08-25) on Iran optimism; gold hit a 3-month high (4695, +6.2% in 5 days) and NEM reached its 52-week high (+47.7% in 20 days), so NEM was closed at its planned date. Copper hit a 1-year high (6.71) and FCX +20.5% in 5 days; NVDA Q2 FY2027 results headline out (title only), plus AWS 2M GPU deal; Canada retaliated with up to 50% tariffs on US goods.
